player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: D'Bewegung muss an der Form [macro micro] mat den Zuelen 0-8 sinn.
invalid_move.out_of_range: All Index muss tëscht 0 an 8 sinn.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: D'Micro_board, Zeil oder Kolonn ass ausserhalb vun der Rei.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: De Spiller muss an der nächster Mikro-Plattform spillen.

game_action.played: Spiller {player_id} gespillt am Mikro-Briet {macro_idx}, Zell {micro_idx} (Rei {row}, Kolonn {col}). Spiller {opponent_id} muss elo am {nxt_txt} spillen.

outcome.win: De Spiller {player_id} gewënnt Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
